title: Apple testbed fails to build when its path contains a space
author: fametrano
body_preview: ### Bug report  The iOS testbed fails to build when it is cloned to a path that contains a space. Its "Process Python libraries" build phase runs `source $PROJECT_DIR/Python.xcframework/build/utils.sh` without quotes, so the shell splits the path at the space.
